instagram_caption:
Jesus... my grandmother didn't know who I was today. She called me by my uncle's name.

His grandmother used to wait at the gate for him every evening. Today she didn't know who he was.

Jesus: "She forgot your name. She didn't forget the love she poured into you."

"Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you."
Isaiah 46:4 (NIV)

Hold her hand anyway. Love doesn't need to be remembered to be real.

youtube_description:
Jesus... my grandmother didn't know who I was today. She called me by my uncle's name.

His grandmother used to wait at the gate for him every evening. Today she didn't know who he was.

Him: Jesus... my grandmother didn't know who I was today. She called me by my uncle's name.

Him: She used to wait at the gate for me. Today she asked if I was the delivery boy.

Jesus: She forgot your name. She didn't forget the love she poured into you.

Him: What's the point of visiting if she won't even remember I came?

Jesus: She'll feel it, even if she can't hold onto it. And you'll remember it for both of you.

Him: I'm scared that next time she won't know anyone at all.

Jesus: Maybe. But she's never been lost to Me. I know her name on the days she can't find yours.

"Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you."
Isaiah 46:4 (NIV)

Jesus: Hold her hand anyway. Love doesn't need to be remembered to be real.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

What's one thing your grandparents taught you that you still carry? 🙏 Tell us in the comments.
